name: pigz
description: Parallel implementation of gzip compression for multi-processor systems

pigz.description: Parallel gzip compression utility that utilizes multiple cores for faster compression
pigz.usage:
pigz file.txt # Compress file.txt to file.txt.gz
pigz -d file.gz # Decompress file.gz (same as unpigz)
pigz -9 file.txt # Maximum compression level
pigz -1 file.txt # Fastest compression
pigz -p 4 file.txt # Use 4 processors/cores
pigz -k file.txt # Keep original file after compression
pigz -c file.txt > compressed.gz # Compress to stdout
pigz -l file.gz # List compressed file information
